clips.title: The story
paras: In Booty Bay, a mercenary named Tokal is seeking a drink in exchange for the truth behind recent attacks on human and dwarven outposts. While rumors point the finger at the Horde, Tokal insists her group was operating under a private mercenary contract.

In the bustling port of Booty Bay, an individual named Tokal is keeping a low profile while watching out for law enforcement. A series of aggressive raids recently devastated human and dwarven camps, fueling rumors that the Horde had orchestrated the attacks. When approached by travelers who clearly do not work for the inquiring marshal, Tokal is quick to push back against the widespread narrative, offering a different version of events in exchange for a drink.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.
The rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.
I'll tell you the whole story if you buy me some grog.
